short_description: Plan household chores, share daily routines and celebrate teamwork with parent-controlled rewards. TidyTroupe is being developed for families using a shared Fire tablet.
long_description:
Team up. Tidy up. Celebrate together.

TidyTroupe is a family chore planner being developed to help households organise daily responsibilities. The design brings chore assignments, recurring schedules and parent-controlled rewards into a calm shared-tablet experience.

Adults can plan age-appropriate tasks using nicknames and illustrated avatars, with a simplified child experience and positive encouragement. The product is designed around local household data and account-free core use.

Planned voice assistance uses push-to-talk and depends on the speech services and languages available on the device. Touch and text alternatives remain part of the experience. Offline core functionality does not imply offline speech recognition.

This is pre-release copy. Confirm every feature against the tested release before submitting. Premium availability, pricing, supported languages and Fire tablet compatibility are not yet final. No cloud sync service is configured.
